title: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Online Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission
vacancyDetails: Senior Instructor (Agricultural Engineering 30, Plant Protection 16, Horticulture 16, Animal Husbandry 14, Agronomy 12, Women Welfare 09, Production 02, Cooperation 08, Panchayat 08, Soil Science 08, Agriculture 01, Agricultural Extension 05, Public Health 03)
qualification: Candidates must satisfy the post-wise qualification listed in the UPSSSC Senior Instructor notification: Bachelor’s / Master’s / Diploma or degree in the relevant agriculture, engineering, economics, sociology, home science, nutrition, public health or related field, as specified in the notification.
ageLimit: Minimum age: 21 years, maximum age: 40 years as on 01 July 2026. Age relaxation as per UPSSSC rules.
applicationFee: General / OBC / EWS : ₹25/-; SC / ST / PH : ₹25/-. Payment through debit card, credit card, internet banking, IMPS, cash card or mobile wallet.
selectionProcess: Shortlisting (PET 2025 score) → Written Examination → Document Verification
documentsRequired: Educational certificates, photo ID, passport photo, signature, category certificate if applicable, and any other documents requested by UPSSSC
howToApply:
1. Visit the official UPSSSC website or click the Apply Online link.
2. Register or login through the UPSSSC portal.
3. Select Senior Instructor advertisement.
4. Fill the form, upload documents and pay the fee.
5. Submit before 05 October 2026 and save the confirmation page.
shortDescription: UPSSSC Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 notification is active. Apply online from 14 September 2026 to 05 October 2026 for 132 posts.
content:
Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released the online form notice for Senior Instructor Recruitment 2026 under Advt. No. 21 Exam 2026.

The application window is open from 14 September 2026 to 05 October 2026. Candidates must satisfy the post-wise age and qualification requirements and submit the form before the final date. The recruitment is for 132 posts across relevant senior instructor disciplines.

Important Dates

  • Online Apply Start Date: 14 September 2026
  • Online Apply Last Date: 05 October 2026
  • Last Date for Fee Payment: 05 October 2026
  • Correction Last Date: 12 October 2026
  • Exam Date: Notify Later
  • Admit Card: Before Exam
  • Result Date: Will Be Updated Here Soon

The recruitment includes multiple senior instructor disciplines such as Agricultural Engineering, Plant Protection, Horticulture, Animal Husbandry, Agronomy, Women Welfare, Production, Cooperation, Panchayat, Soil Science, Agriculture and Public Health. Read the official notification before applying.
